public.text: The section focuses on stopping new technical silos but does not address governance, financing, contractual, or data silos within otherwise standards-based systems.
public.suggestedRevision: Require shared governance, data stewardship, reference identifiers, semantic alignment, access arrangements, funding coordination, and lifecycle management in addition to interface conformance.
